senses.gloss: वल् val, pratyāhāra for all consonants but y.

वल्ल valla, m. kind of wheat;
 a certain weight.
वलक vala-ka, n. procession.
वलन्तिका valant-ikā, f. kind of gesticulation.

वलभि valabhi (or more commonly ī), ridge 🞄of a roof, top or pinnacle of a house;
 ikā, 🞄f. dim. of id..

वलभी valabhī, f., v. valabhi;
 N. of a town 🞄in Saurāṣṭra.
वल्लभी vallabhī, f. N. of a town.
वलभिद् vala-bhid, m. smiter of Vala, Indra.

 i-mat, a. having a — 🞄creeper (—˚).

 cloth made of bark, bark garment: 🞄-vat, a. wearing a garment made of bark, 🞄-ajina-saṃvīta, pp. clothed in bark and 🞄skins.

 🞄n. cloth or garment made of bark (valka).

 🞄wearing a garment made of bark.
वल्कवासस् valka-vāsas, n. garment made 🞄of bark.
वल्गु valg-ú, a. (f. id.) comely, handsome, 🞄fine, lovely, attractive (esp. of sound, voice, 🞄speech).
वल्गुलिका valgul-ikā, f. box, chest.
वल्भ् VALBH, Ⅰ. Ā. valbha, eat (very 🞄rare).

 n. N. of 🞄a locality: -agra, n. N. of a peak of Rāmagiri.

 also 🞄spelt bálśa).

 m. pl. a 🞄class of Ṛṣis of the size of a thumb and 🞄connected with the sun.

वाल्मीकि vālmīki, m. N. of an ancient sage, 🞄composer of the Rāmāyaṇa: ī-ya, a. connected 🞄with or composed by Vālmīki.
